A canonical CPU witness is scientifically sound **as proof of initialization under fixed reference arithmetic**, provided it reads the current live CUDA state. It does not establish CPU/CUDA numerical equivalence. This follows the repository’s existing [CPU reference construction](/home/rb/worktrees/sfora-positive-causality/scripts/train_siglip2_identity_diversity.py:529); forcing identical device kernels would instead change the frozen computational procedure.

Zero C makes initialization outputs blind to mu errors, so output equality cannot replace explicit mu/C bindings.
